simple.meaning: חׇכְמָה (chokmâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “wisdom (in a good sense).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 149 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at Exodus 28:3. Its contexts include family line, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חׇכְמָה (H2451).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חׇכְמָה (chokmâh) / H2451 is traced through Exodus 28:3, Exodus 31:3, Exodus 31:6, Exodus 35:26 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2451. chokmah חָכְמה noun feminine wisdom , ׳ח Exod 28:3 106t.; construct חָכְמַת 35:35 15 t.; suffix חָכְמָתִי Eccl 2:9 , etc. + 25 t. suffix; plural abstract emphatic חָכְמוֺת Psa 49:4 ; Prov 1:20 ; 9:1 ; 24:7 ; חַכְמוֺת 14:1 (in correctly pointed as adjective construct f.; read חָכְמוֺת De); — 1 skill in war Isa 10:13 ; in technical work Exod 28:3 ; 31:3 , 6 ; 35:26 , 31 , 35 ; 36:1-2 ,(P), compare 1Kin 7:14 ; 1Chr 28:21 ; of sailors Psa 107:27 . 2 wisdom , in administration Deut 34:9 ; Isa 29:14 ; Jer 49:7 (twice in verse); 2Sam 14:20 ; of prince of Tyre Ezek 28:4-5 , 7 , 12 ; 29:12 , 17 ; Solomon's wisdom included this with other forms of cleverness and shrewdness 1Kin 2:6 ; 3:28 ; 5:9 ; 5:10 ; 5:14 (twice in verse); 1 Kings 5:26; 10:4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 23 , 24 2Chr 9:3 ; 9:5 ; 9:6 ; 9:7 ; 9:22 ; 9:23 , 1Kin 11:41 ; 2Chr 1:10 ; 1:11 ; 1:12 ; the Messiah is to have וּבִינָה חָכְמָה רוּחַ Isa 11:2 . 3 shrewdness, wisdom , 2Sam 20:22 ; 1Kin 5:10 (twice in verse); Jer 9:22 ; withheld by God from the ostrich Job 39:17 ; of magicians and prophets Isa 47:10 ; Dan 1:4 , 17 , 20 . 4 wisdom, prudence in religious affairs Deut 4:6 ; Psa 37:30 ; 51:8 ; 90:12 ; Prov 10:31 ; Isa 33:6 ; Jer 8:9 5 wisdom , ethical and religious: a. of God, as a divine attribute or energy ; his wisdom is in the skies Job 38:36 ; by it he numbers the clouds 38:37 ; founded the earth Prov 3:19 ; and made all things Jer 10:12 = 51:15 , Psa 104:24 ; it is with him Job 12:13 ; not to be found by the most persevering human search 28:12 , 20 ; he alone knows it 28:23 ; gives it Prov 2:6 ; and shows its secrets Job 11:6 . b. the divine wisdom is personified : she was begotten before all things to be the architect and counsellor of God in the creation ( Prov 8:22-31 ); she builds a palace and spreads a feast for those who will receive her instruction 9:1 (compare 9:2-5 ); she teaches in public 1:20 ; 8:1 , 5 , 11 , 12 (see context); gives her pupils the divine spirit 1:23 ; by her discipline simple become wise, rulers rule wisely, and those seeking her are richly rewarded 8:14 (compare 8:1-21 ). c. of man : to get wisdom is principal thing Prov 4:7 (twice in verse); its fundamental principle is to fear God Psa 111:10 ; Prov 15:33 ; Job 28:18 (|| בִּינָה מֵרַע סוּר ); and know ׳י , the All Holy Prov 9:10 ; 30:3 ; it is of inestimable worth Job 28:18 ; Prov 8:11 ; 16:16 ; 17:16 ; 23:23 ; 24:7 ; beyond the reach of scorners 14:6 ; God giveth it to the good Eccl 2:26 ; men are to incline the ear Prov 2:2 ; attend unto wisdom 5:1 ; seek Eccl 7:25 ; know Prov 24:14 ; Eccl 1:17 ; 8:16 ; behold 2:12 ; 9:13 ; get her Prov 4:5 , 7 ; treat her as sister 7:4 ; happy the man who finds her 3:13 ; he who has wisdom is תְּבוּנָה אִישׁ 10:23 ; נָבוֺן 10:13 ; 14:33 ; מֵבִין 17:24 ; compare also Psa 49:4 ; Job 4:21 ; 12:2 , 12 ; 13:5 ; 15:8 ; 26:3 ; 32:7 , 13 ; 33:33 ; Prov 1:2 , 7 ; 2:10 ; 4:11 ; 11:2 ; 13:10 ; 14:1 , 8 ; 18:4 ; 21:30 ; 24:3 ; 28:26 ; 29:3 , 15 ; 31:26 ; Eccl 1:13 , 16 (twice in verse); 1:18 ; 2:3 , 9 , 13 , 21 ; 7:10-11 , 12 , 19 , 23 ; 8:1 ; 9:10 , 15 , 16 (twice in verse); 9:18 ; 10:1 , 10 — on solomon's wisdom see above
